name: Double Jump Troll Tower
desc:
🎉 Welcome To Double Jump Troll Tower! Do you have what it takes to survive the Trolls, Obstacles and Slaps in this tower?
⬆️ Tap the Jump Button Twice to Double Jump!

How to Play:
🪤Avoid Troll Traps & Slaps from other players!
🏆 Reach the top of the Tower for Cash, a OP Slap Hand and a Flying Carpet!
😂 Use Troll Tools to slap Players & Friends into the Void! 
🛒 Use Cash to purchase better Troll Tools and HD Admin! ✅ Your purchased tools & Admin Save!
🎁 Wait for the Lucky Block & Void Slap at the top for additional EXCLUSIVE rewards
💯 Complete Towers in the lobby for a invisibility cloak, and ABILITY Slap!

💻 Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players are supported! ✅ Your purchased Tools and Admin save automatically!

✔️ Premium Benefits: +5 Walkspeed to help reach the top Faster!
